runtime: Python 3.13/3.14 on supported Windows 10/11 Beta targets
sqlite: Authoritative Infrastructure state uses LLD-01 SQLite STRICT tables, FK enforcement, WAL/read snapshots and short BEGIN IMMEDIATE writes; no graph database or separately administered server.

normalization.address: ADDRESS_MATCH_V1 defined by algorithms/address-duplicates.json and used only for duplicate candidates
normalization.ip: stdlib ipaddress canonicalization defined by algorithms/ip-normalization.json

xlsx.preflight: reuse the hardened ZIP/path/resource/active-content principles established by LLD-04 through a shared implementation utility; Infrastructure owns its own workbook profile and staging authority
xlsx.semantic_reader: openpyxl read-only streaming mode, data_only=false, keep_links=false, formulas rejected in authoritative cells
xlsx.writer: openpyxl write-only mode for template/discovery/round-trip exports; no formulas/macros/external links
xlsx.dependency_gate: one LLD-12 pinned openpyxl version must pass both LLD-04 malicious workbook fixtures and LLD-08 round-trip/security fixtures on Python 3.13/3.14

workbook_identity: SHA-256 is used for deterministic logical/file identity and replay detection, not authenticity proof; same-installation targeting relies on explicit installation scope + immutable local identity columns, never hash/name/serial/IP alone.
containment: Iterative indexed parent-chain walk rather than recursive Python call stack; database current-parent cardinality plus service cycle validation.
rack_occupancy: Integer U interval arithmetic and indexed overlap queries; no floating-point placement semantics.
secrets: Input validation rejects password/private-key/token/recovery-code/credential-like workbook headers or domain fields. Logs/audit carry only bounded redacted error/reference data.
deferred: No SSH client, SNMP, network scanner, interface/port model, graph engine, reachability library or topology package is part of Beta 1.0 dependencies.
